solves.reason: 보편화된 문학연구엔 특별한 어려움(special), 보편언어는 결여(lacking), 일반인엔 불가능(impossible)
solves.reasoning: special difficulty / language still lacking / impossible for laymen → special-lacking-impossible

solves.reason: 번역으로 가치 상실(lost), 작품은 자연스럽게(naturally) 흐름, 지방색은 생생함(vivid)
solves.reasoning: value lost through translation / naturally flows / most vivid → lost-naturally-vivid

solves.reason: 문학=감정의 발현(manifestation), 의도적(deliberate) 재현, 단어와 밀접(closely)
solves.reasoning: manifestation of emotions / deliberate representation / closely related → manifestation-deliberate-closely

solves.reason: ① minor difficulty는 부적절, 글은 특별한(special) 어려움을 주장
solves.reasoning: 글 전체가 큰 어려움을 논하므로 ① minor는 special이어야 함

solves.reason: ④ loosely related는 부적절, 단어 바뀌면 정서도 바뀔 만큼 밀접(closely)
solves.reasoning: once words change, thoughts change → 밀접(closely)해야 함, loosely 부적절

solves.reason: ③ value gained는 부적절, 번역으로 가치는 상실(lost)됨
solves.reasoning: value and enjoyment may be lost through translation → gained 부적절

solves.reason: how ___ is a translation to the original → 충실한(faithful)
solves.reasoning: 번역이 원작에 충실한지 묻는 맥락 → faithful

solves.reason: Literature is the ___ of emotions → 발현(manifestation)
solves.reasoning: 문학은 감정과 영감의 발현 → manifestation

solves.reason: emotions and ___ → 창작 원천 영감(inspirations)
solves.reasoning: emotions와 병렬되는 창작의 원천 → inspirations

solves.reason: difficulty(어려움) ≈ hardship
solves.reasoning: difficulty = 어려움/곤란 → hardship

solves.reason: manifestation(발현) ≈ expression
solves.reasoning: manifestation = 드러남/표현 → expression

solves.reason: deliberate(의도적인) ≈ intentional
solves.reasoning: deliberate = 고의의/의도적인 → intentional

solves.reason: faithful(충실한) ↔ distorted(왜곡된)
solves.reasoning: faithful=원작에 충실 ↔ distorted=왜곡된; loyal은 동의어 함정

solves.reason: impossible(불가능한) ↔ feasible(실현가능한)
solves.reasoning: impossible ↔ feasible; possible은 접두사 제거형이라 배제, feasible이 정답

solves.reason: (A) local color=특색, (B) paint color=색깔
solves.reasoning: A는 문학의 지방색(특색), B는 물감의 실제 색 → 특색-색깔

solves.reason: 전문지식 없는 사람들 → laymen
solves.reasoning: people without professional knowledge → laymen(비전문가)

solves.reason: 주어 the work(3인칭 단수) 현재시제 → flows
solves.reasoning: the work naturally ___ (flow) → 3인칭 단수 현재 flows

solves.reason: can never be + p.p. 수동태 → repeated
solves.reasoning: can never be ___ (repeat) → be+과거분사 수동태 repeated

solves.reason: value and enjoyment may be ___ → lost through translation
solves.reasoning: 번역 충실도 의문 뒤 원작 가치가 번역으로 상실 → lost through translation

solves.reason: vivid to local people, but ___ → means nothing to others
solves.reasoning: 현지인엔 생생하지만 대조적으로 타인엔 의미없음 → means nothing to others
